analysis.summary: F-CLEAN-001: BipartiteGraph.jsx is 1309 lines (verified via wc -l), about 3.3x the 400-line plan target. Five concerns are interleaved in one function: D3 draw, filters, sorting, export, statistics/UI. The plan task names the three extract targets: filters, export, and layout. Extraction leaves a thin shell component (state + effects + JSX) and three pure modules: useBipartiteFilters (hook), useBipartiteExport (hook or util trio), and useBipartiteLayout (hook that owns the D3 effect). The export functions are the cleanest first cut — they are 3 self-contained async/sync functions of ~30-60 lines each.
analysis.details: Current implementation: BipartiteGraph.jsx holds 11 useState hooks (tooltip, selectedNode, isolatedView, searchTerm, selectedPlatformFilter, minDetections, showMultiPlatformOnly, showWidespreadOnly, domainSort, platformSort, plus 5 show* panel toggles), 5 useMemo hooks (graphData, filteredData, sortedData, stats_data, availablePlatforms), one useEffect (click-outside for export menu), one draw effect (the D3 force render), and 3 export functions (handleExportCSV, handleExportPNG, handleExportSVG) plus a private escapeCSV. The clean split per the plan task is: (a) extract the three export functions plus escapeCSV into src/dashboard/components/bipartite/export.js (or a folder of three files). (b) Extract the filter logic and the availablePlatforms useMemo into a useBipartiteFilters hook (returns {filteredData, availablePlatforms, filterState, filterSetters}). (c) Extract the D3 draw effect into a useBipartiteLayout hook (takes sortedData + svgRef, owns the effect). After extraction the shell is the JSX tree, the stats useMemo, and the state that lives across concerns (selectedNode, isolatedView, tooltip). Verification per the issue body: `wc -l src/dashboard/components/BipartiteGraph.jsx` should be <400. The plan also allows 'the extracted modules are listed in the PR' as an alternative acceptance path, so listing the three new files in the PR body is acceptable if the line count does not fall under 400 by extraction alone.

decision_record.residual_risk: The D3 draw effect closes over tooltip/isolatedView/selectedNode state. Moving it into useBipartiteLayout means the hook must accept a stable callback bag. If the closure breaks, the tooltip and isolated-view interactions will silently fail — #29's new App.jsx tab test will not catch this (it does not exercise BipartiteGraph), so the resolver must manually verify the Bipartite interactions after the split.
